record_kind: Validator adaptation history, not candidate rejection or linguistic findings

changes.issue: A predecessor assumption required nonempty author uncertainty lists.
changes.evidence: 85 actual rows explicitly contain an empty list.
changes.resolution: Require the field and a list, permit explicit empty lists, and preserve the exact frozen original author list. Nonempty caveat deletion and arbitrary replacement are rejected.

changes.issue: A predecessor assumption required duplicated inherited-count and reviewer-instruction metadata in every author group.
changes.evidence: Romanian groups do not contain these optional duplicated fields.
changes.resolution: Keep mandatory source/foundation count 150; preserve reviewer instructions exactly when present, including their absence when absent. No candidate metadata was manufactured.

changes.issue: A draft negative-control mutation attempted list deletion on the correction-ledger qualifications field.
changes.evidence: The actual field is a string; the draft test raised AttributeError before validation.
changes.resolution: Mutate the actual string field and verify the frozen-ledger guard rejects it. No candidate or ledger bytes were changed.

changes.issue: Qualification carry needed an exact normalized list rather than subset-only containment.
changes.evidence: All 110 actual rows use de-duplicated source notes followed by original author qualifications.
changes.resolution: Require that exact normalized list. Twelve additional actual-packet controls reject added unsupported or duplicated qualifications.

current_result: All 110 frozen candidates pass; final ordinary and optimized controls pass identically. No production bytes changed and no linguistic verdict inferred.
